blogPost1Title: Paying with crypto in Bhutan: what to know before you go
blogPost1Note: A quick primer on scanning a merchant QR, reviewing your quote and approving a payment from your own wallet.
blogPost2Title: How your exchange rate is set
blogPost2Note: A look at the daily Partner Bank rate, when it refreshes and how fees are shown before you approve.
blogPost3Title: 5 ways to keep your wallet secure while traveling
blogPost3Note: Simple habits for protecting your recovery phrase, your device and your linked wallet on the road.
blogPost1Body1: Paying in Bhutan starts the same way every time: the merchant shows a QR code, you scan it with NomiPay, and the amount appears in ngultrum before anything moves.
blogPost1Body2: The quote you see is the one you approve. It carries the merchant's price, today's Partner Bank rate and every fee in a single figure, so nothing changes between the counter and your wallet.
blogPost1Body3: Nothing leaves your wallet until you confirm. NomiPay never holds your keys — it prepares the payment, you approve it, and the merchant is settled in their own currency.
blogPost2Body1: Your rate comes from the Partner Bank's daily reference rate rather than a spread of our own. It refreshes once a day and is stamped on every quote you are shown.
blogPost2Body2: A quote is valid for a short window. If it expires before you approve it, NomiPay asks for a fresh one instead of settling at a price you never agreed to.
blogPost2Body3: Fees are a separate line, never folded into the rate. What the merchant receives, what the network costs and what NomiPay charges are all visible before you confirm.
blogPost3Body1: Your recovery phrase is the wallet. Keep it off your phone, out of your photos and away from any chat — anyone who reads it can spend everything, from anywhere.
blogPost3Body2: Lock the device itself. A passcode, biometrics and a short auto-lock do more for your funds on the road than any setting inside an app.
blogPost3Body3: Review what you have connected. Unlink wallets you no longer carry, check your active sessions after a trip, and approve payments only on a screen you can read in full.
